Use a Svelte 5 project. Save a single example as App.svelte unless file names say otherwise. The Svelte compiler is required; these snippets do not run as plain HTML or JavaScript.

blocks.title: Run and clean up an effect

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `$state` marks a Svelte value as reactive so the page can follow its later changes.
`$effect` starts outside work after a Svelte update. A returned function cleans up before rerun or removal.

blocks.text: The timer increments the state. Cleanup stops that timer when the component is removed.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use effects for outside work such as timers. Use $derived for a value that can be calculated from state.
